about: Edit treatments Video Mania can offer on the menu: a way of treating a film or a piece of footage, built from one or more engines. 'fits' says what the user must have given (footage, voiceover, topic, product). The Pocket indexes these as kind 'treatment'.

treatments.name: Voxel diorama with a pixel-art cast
treatments.summary: One dark 3D voxel room the whole film lives in, two pixel-art sprite characters who act the story, warm lamp light with shallow depth of field, word-by-word type with a red punch word, pixel-dissolve transitions. For explainers, launches and creator videos that need a host.

treatments.name: Switch into pixel art on punchlines
treatments.summary: Live footage (podcast, talking head) that, on chosen words, breaks into a mosaic and becomes a pixel-art version of the moment, then resolves back. Cut on the transcript's word times.

treatments.name: Full pixel-art scene
treatments.summary: A whole scene drawn pixel by pixel in code at low resolution with a 12-colour palette, stepped 12 fps animation, precomputed physics and chiptune sound. From a reference image or a one-line idea.

treatments.name: Vox editorial poster look
treatments.summary: Editorial poster frames in bold colour fields with cut-out imagery and strong type, timed to a voiceover. The house Vox look from the user's reference reel.

treatments.name: Paper-collage explainer
treatments.summary: Halftone paper cut-outs on flat colour that slide in and assemble like stop motion. As a full explainer or as 5-second B-roll under a line of voiceover.

treatments.name: Kinetic word-by-word captions
treatments.summary: Captions that land on each spoken word with one emphasised punch word per line, in the type kit's roles. For any footage or voiceover.

treatments.name: Tight talking-head cut
treatments.summary: Removes retakes, false starts and pauses on word boundaries, with punch-ins and clean audio joins. The base for every footage edit.

treatments.name: Edit it like these reference videos
treatments.summary: Give 3 to 6 videos you like. Their cut speed, zooms, captions, graphics and sound are measured into a saved style, and your video is edited that way. Editing grammar only, never their footage or words.

treatments.name: One-take product launch
treatments.summary: A launch film with no cuts: every beat grows out of the one before and one camera follows it all. Personal, non-commercial use.

treatments.name: A named film style
treatments.summary: The whole film in one of 68 code-made styles, from watercolour and ink wash to newsreel, blueprint, LiDAR survey and broadcast news package.

treatments.name: A painting that moves
treatments.summary: Art-history styles brought to life: 50 painting styles that animate, or 83 media drawn stroke by stroke as if by hand.

treatments.name: Hand-drawn character animation
treatments.summary: A brush-drawn 2D character with boiling linework acting out a short story, shot by shot, with no on-screen text.

treatments.name: 3D product shot
treatments.summary: A picture of the product becomes a 3D model that a camera flies around under real lights. Rendered on the GPU with raea, no Blender.

treatments.name: Coded motion-graphics explainer
treatments.summary: UI mockups, icons, data visuals and kinetic type choreographed to a voiceover with measured eases and a moving camera. The default Video Mania film.

treatments.name: Shorts from a long video
treatments.summary: Finds the strongest moments in a long video or podcast and edits each into a vertical short.

treatments.name: A proven social format
treatments.summary: Two-person podcast, street interview, ranking listicle, short drama, presenter explainer or narrated demo, built to that format's rules.

treatments.name: Generated cinematic B-roll
treatments.summary: Real-world shots made with Google Flow Omni Flash to sit under the voiceover. Each generation needs your approval.

treatments.name: Whiteboard draw-on
treatments.summary: An illustration drawn line by line as if by a hand, lines first, then colour. From a ChatGPT picture or drawn in code in 32 doodle styles.

treatments.name: Math and diagram explainer
treatments.summary: Precise diagrams, graphs and equations that build and transform step by step, in the 3Blue1Brown manner (Manim).

treatments.name: Vector and stick-figure animation
treatments.summary: Flat vector characters and stick figures rigged from simple shapes, animated with the 12 principles, or Lottie and SVG animations played on the timeline.

treatments.name: Kinetic 3D typography
treatments.summary: Words as the picture: type that slams, extrudes, tunnels and turns in 3D on the beat, from one-word hits to a word corridor.

treatments.name: A world to move through
treatments.summary: A built environment the cast walks through and the camera travels in: generate one concept picture, rebuild it as a 3D set in data (no Blender), then film inside it. A night cafe ships as the first set.

treatments.name: Step into a generated picture
treatments.summary: Any generated picture becomes a world with real camera depth: a depth map made on the laptop pushes the picture into relief, the cast stands in front, and near parts slide faster than far parts as the camera moves. A new world costs one picture.
